stories.title: Xaba finally wins an Absa Run Your City race in 2026
stories.summary: Glenrose Xaba has achieved a significant victory in the inaugural Mangaung 10K race. The Boxer Athletic Club star successfully held off a strong international competitor to secure her win in Bloemfontein.
stories.angle: This is good news as it highlights a South African athlete's success on a national stage.
